repos_data.description: Run the native 284B-A13B DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 LLM locally on one laptop CPU: pure C, 8 GB RAM minimum, no GPU, best TPOT 0.892 s/token, resident OpenAI-compatible API with function tools. | 在笔记本单颗 CPU 上本地运行原生 284B-A13B DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 大模型：纯 C，最低 8 GB 内存，无需 GPU，最优 TPOT 0.892 秒/token，支持模型常驻的 OpenAI 兼容接口与函数工具。
⚡ Pure-Rust WebGPU inference engine — OpenAI-API compatible, GGUF native, runs on any GPU. No Python. No llama.cpp. Single binary.
Off Grid AI — private, on-device AI. Run open models (text, vision, image, voice) locally through one OpenAI-compatible gateway. No cloud, no accounts, no API keys.
Local AI app and inference engine for agents. Run open-weight LLMs locally — private, 100% offline on your computer. Join our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/8wGSsvmg4V
A collection of all available inference solutions for the LLMs
Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models. Supports GGUF, MLX, Qwen3.8, Kimi K3, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, FLUX and more.

~95% on SimpleQA (e.g. Qwen3.6-27B on a 3090). Supports all local and cloud LLMs (llama.cpp, Ollama, Google, ...). 10+ search engines - arXiv, PubMed, your private documents. Everything Local & Encrypted.

Kubernetes operator for self-hosted LLM inference across a heterogeneous GPU fleet: NVIDIA CUDA, AMD Vulkan, and Apple Silicon Metal. Runtimes: llama.cpp, vLLM, TGI, mlx-server. Multi-GPU sharding, model caching, OpenAI-compatible endpoints. Apache-2.0, run across homelab and on-prem fleets, actively developed.

Dockerized OpenAI-compatible wrapper for Kokoro-82M text-to-speech w/multiplatform CPU, AMD, NVIDIA GPU PyTorch; multi-speaker, voice-mixing, auto-stitching, caption timestamps, SSML, readalong web UI
Port of OpenAI's Whisper model in C/C++
QA-Pilot is an interactive chat project that leverages online/local LLM for rapid understanding and navigation of GitHub code repository.
